item.title: A tree, a promise, a memory: Ballymena marks Holocaust Remembrance
item.description: A living symbol of remembrance now stands in the heart of Ballymena after a ‘Tree of Hope’ was planted in People’s Park to commemorate the millions murdered during the Holocaust. The commemorative cherry tree, accompanied by an inscribed plaque, was planted on Friday 27 February 2026 during a special civic ceremony hosted by the Mayor of Mid and East Antrim, Councillor Jackson Minford , alongside pupils from Cambridge House Grammar School .
